Volunteers currently need repeated back-and-forth to complete workshop signup. We propose a **two-week pilot with 20 volunteers** to test a simpler flow intended to remove that back-and-forth.

Success would mean **at least 16 of the 20 volunteers completing signup without assistance**, based on observed completion. The pilot would not establish that a full public rollout is ready.

The estimated cost is **$8,000, excluding tax**. The supplier quote is pending, and the venue is unconfirmed. No start date, decision deadline, or delivery owner has been agreed.

Please approve the **pilot approach only**. This is not a request to authorize spending before the supplier quote arrives.
